items.title: 米4州でトランスジェンダーの権利制限承認、大統領選に向け民主党の課題に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Leah Douglas

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Leah Douglas

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - 米国で３日に行われた中間選挙では、ワシントン、コロラド、アリゾナ、ネブラスカの４州の住民投票で、トランスジェンダーの権利を制限する措置が承認された。民主党は中間選挙で勝利し、議会上下両院の主導権を奪回したが、トランスジェンダー問題では党内で意見が割れており、２０２８年の大統領選に向けて政治的な課題が残った形だ。

４州では住民投票で、トランスジェンダーの子どもが自身の性自認に合ったスポーツチームで競技することを禁止する措置や、未成年者への性別適合手術を禁止する措置が承認された。

このうちワシントン、コロラド、アリゾナの３州では、州議会議席と各州選出の連邦議会議席のいずれも民主党が過半数を獲得しており、民主党候補に投票した有権者の間にも、トランスジェンダーを巡る問題で共和党の主張を受け入れる層が一定数存在することが読み取れる。

４月のロイター／イプソス調査では、トランスジェンダー選手が学校の女子スポーツに参加することの禁止に６７％が賛成し、民主党支持層でも４４％が支持した。

共和党は中間選挙の選挙戦で、トランスジェンダー女子選手の女子スポーツへの参加や、未成年者への性別適合医療などを巡り、民主党候補がリベラルに傾きすぎていると印象付ける攻撃広告を展開した。

一方、民主党候補の対応は分かれた。保守寄りの姿勢を打ち出す候補もいれば、トランスジェンダーの権利支持を維持する候補や、この問題への言及を避ける候補もいた。

ＬＧＢＴＱの権利擁護団体「アウト・ネブラスカ」のレイチェル・トムリンソン・ディック事務局長は、住民投票での可決について、「落胆させられる結果だ」と述べ、今後の選挙でも同様の住民投票が実施されると予想している。

民主党は２０２４年の大統領選でも、共和党によるトランスジェンダー問題を巡る攻勢に十分に対応できなかった。党として一貫した対応を打ち出すことができず、この点が、カマラ・ハリス前副大統領が敗北を喫した要因の一つとの見方が多い。

ただ、トランスジェンダー問題で共和党に歩み寄っても、新たな支持獲得にはつながりにくく、ＬＧＢＴＱの有権者や党内の進歩派の支持を失う恐れがあるとの指摘もある。

items.title: 環境保護団体もＡＩ活用、データセンターの負荷には警鐘
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ワシントン　７日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ワシントン　７日　ロイター］ - 世界各地の環境団体が、気候データの分析や森林火災の監視、絶滅危惧種の個体数調査に人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用している。電力需要や水使用量、温室効果ガスの排出量を急増させていると自ら警告してきた技術を、積極的に取り入れている。

米非営利団体コンサベーション・インターナショナルのＡＩ責任者、アリ・スワンソン氏は「ＡＩには環境面の代償が伴う場合があり、使い方を慎重に考える必要があることは認識している」と述べた。「ただ気候と生物多様性の危機への対応が一段と急務になる中、ＡＩはわれわれの行動を速め、収集している情報をより有効に活用する助けになる」とした。

ロイターは環境保護、自然保護、開発支援に携わる主要１５団体にＡＩの利用状況を取材した。全ての団体が何らかの形でＡＩを利用していると回答する一方、ＡＩを支えるデータセンターの環境への影響に懸念を示した。

ＡＩの恩恵と甚大なリスクのバランスをどう取るかは世界的なジレンマであり、今月の国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）でも注目を集める見通し。開催国トルコは、ＡＩの持続可能な開発と導入を確保するための原則を示した誓約への署名を呼びかける予定だ。

Nov 9 : Nvidia's board is probing whether CEO Jensen Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, after a media report alleged he had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to Beijing.
Here's what people are saying:
DONALD TRUMP, US PRESIDENT:
"I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what is going on. I hope everything's fine ... I think he's an honourable guy."

BILL ACKMAN, PERSHING SQUARE CEO:
"I am not suggesting he gets a free pass. If indeed this is more than an affair, then it is obviously a real problem. I like the guy. He has done a lot of good for the world and I hope the damage here is minimal. That is, I am hoping for a simple affair, not a risk to our national security."
MOHAMED A. EL-ERIAN, FORMER PIMCO CEO:
"While Nvidia has sought to reassure us all, there are several layers here, beginning with the unfortunate timing. For example: The company is systemically important for tech, markets and the economy; Investors tend to struggle to price in key-person and governance issues; and there are fluid national security and geopolitical dynamics."
JOSH GILBERT, LEAD ANALYST AT ETORO:
"This boardroom storm has landed at a brutal time for the AI trade, but Nvidia’s earnings on 17 November are the real next test. While the investigation is likely to dent sentiment, it won’t alter anything long-term unless it leads to a change at the top, at which point it becomes a completely different ball game."
CHRIS WESTON, HEAD OF RESEARCH, PEPPERSTONE:
"Will Huang get replaced? No, I don't think that's going to happen. I think given that he is like the godfather of AI and, you know, the OG of what has been the biggest investment thematic that we've seen in a generation, I mean, I think if we genuinely thought he was going to step down ... the stock would be down - it would be an absolute bloodbath, to be honest.
"If it is found out that she's confirmed as a spy, then, crikey, it doesn't go well."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Thousands of goats could be slaughtered due to U.S. tariffs
items.author: Heather Wright
items.summary: Bruce and Sharon VandenBerg have been producing goat cheese since 1989, first on their farm in Lindsay, Ont., and now at a state-of-the-art facility that employs roughly 200 people.
items.body: LINDSAY, Ont. – Bruce and Sharon VandenBerg have been producing goat cheese since 1989, first on their farm in Lindsay, Ont., and now at a state-of-the-art facility that employs roughly 200 people. Mariposa Dairy has grown exponentially over the years, but its future became uncertain in a matter of days. “It was announced on (Sept. 8) and the tariffs came in on September the 15th. We had six days notice, six days,” said Bruce VandenBerg. In September, U.S. President Donald Trump issued 50 per cent tariffs on a wide range of Canadian goods, including goat dairy. Mariposa sends 80 per cent of its product south of the border, providing private-label products to companies like Costco and Trader Joe’s. The company says the tariffs are costing roughly $1 million a week, a cost being shouldered by everyone from the farms to the producers to the distributors. “Everybody’s trying to take a little piece of the pain in order to try to make this work,” said Mariposa Dairy CEO Mark Anderson. “So while Mariposa Dairy takes a big piece of the impact of the tariff, our distributors taking a piece, our suppliers are taking a piece. And that’s how we’re trying to make it work for the short term.” But the short term is now dragging into the long term, and while the company says it is not quite at a breaking point, it is getting close. “Most companies could just stop and cut their supply off,” said VandenBerg. “But we have 200 dairy goat farms that are relying on us to take their milk.” “The goats milk every day,” added Anderson. “So we got to keep taking the milk, and it needs to flow because it doesn’t have anywhere else to go.” Mariposa gets its milk from roughly 50,000 goats across the province. So far, the company has been able to keep its purchasing volumes the same, but if it has to reduce the amount of milk it purchases, farms would be forced to slaughter portions of their herds. “(If) this trade policy does not get figured out, there will be a lot of goats culled,” said farmer Gabe Benschop, who has about 800 goats. “There will be either firms going out of business or farmers having to cut back.” While Mariposa distributes its product across Canada, there is not enough demand here to absorb the amount of cheese it produces. Conversely, the United States does not produce enough goat milk to meet its domestic demand. “They probably need to import 30 to 35 per cent of their goat cheese in order to meet their demand,” said Anderson. One of Mariposa’s largest distributors is Gellert Global Group, a New Jersey-based food importer that is suing Trump and the U.S. government over the 50 per cent tariffs. Gellert typically imports about US$80 million of Canadian cheese into the United States each year. If that lawsuit is successful, the 50 per cent tariffs would be void. “I’m really hopeful that in the first part of the new year, common sense kicks into place,” said VandenBerg. “We expanded based on a 16-year CUSMA agreement, and here we are in year six,” he said, referring to the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement that was negotiated during Trump’s first term in office. But that lawsuit is not set to be heard until January and the company says it cannot sustain the status quo until then. “I mean, ideally, if they could negotiate a solution, it would be best,” said Anderson. “Failing that, we’re going to need some type of financial support, to make it through this.

items.title: US-Iran war: What is Trump's ‘Task Force Iron Gate’? How will land ‘blockade’ impact Tehran, its economy? Explained
items.author: Akriti Anand
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said in a TRUTH Social post that the Iron Gate, “coupled with history’s greatest Naval Blockade,” allows “very little gets into, or out of, Iran.”
items.body: Iran, which is already reeling under crippling economic conditions, faced a major blow on Sunday as US President Donald Trump announced that a "Task Force Iron Gate is in full force and effect in the Islamic Republic."He said in a TRUTH Social post that the Iron Gate, "coupled with history’s greatest Naval Blockade," allows "very little gets into, or out of, Iran."What is 'Operation Iron Gate' exactly, and what will it do?The US Central Command (CENTCOM) said the newly established task force will coordinate with other US government agencies to prevent the movement of advanced weapons systems, dual-use technologies, sanctioned materials and illegal revenue streams across Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea.After announcing the imposition of 'Task Force Iron Gate' in Iran, Trump explained what it really means. He told reporters, "We have Operation Iron Gate that just went into effect."He claimed the move has successfully choked off virtually all incoming and outgoing trade for the Islamic Republic."That means nothing comes in by land, and as you know with the naval blockade, nothing comes in by water," he added.Trump said the US is trying to end the war with Iran and "we are doing well because all we have to do is choking it off, so we have it very well blocked off."Meanwhile, the US Central Command said the "Task Force" was launched "to disrupt Iranian ground transit routes supporting illegal shipments.""On Nov. 7, the commander of US Central Command (CENTCOM) directed the establishment of a task force that will support ongoing US government efforts to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials," the US CENTCOM said.What does US aim to achieve?The establishment of the task force is the latest illustration of how the US is still searching for ways to increase pressure on Tehran, more than eight months after launching with Israel a war against the Islamic Republic, according to Reuters.Beyond imposing the restriction on the movement of weapons, the "Task Force" will also focus on halting the flow of dual-use technologies used by Iran and stemming what Washington calls illegal revenue streams.The CENTCOM quoted Cooper as saying, "The establishment of Task Force Iron Gate reinforces the success of our ironclad blockade against Iran at sea.""Strengthening CENTCOM's collaboration with US interagency partners will further constrain Iran's ability to finance terrorism, rebuild weapons factories, and replenish their military," he said.Who forms the 'Task Force Iron Gate'?The CENTCOM said the "Task Force Iron Gate," formed on the directions by dm. Brad Cooper, has an "internal staff of approximately 20 civilian and military personnel based in Tampa, Florida." What prompted US action?A Reuters investigation found Iran has created a secret network of military agencies to import at least $2 billion in hardware, explosives and heavy-duty trucks since January 2025, evading both the US naval blockade and Western sanctions.The material entered Iran by cargo ship across the Caspian Sea from Russia, by truck from Central Asia, and by freight planes from China, the Reuters investigation showed.$25 billion loss: Impact of blockade on Iran's economyThe US imposed a naval blockade and maritime restrictions on the Strait of Hormuz, a key trade route, targeting Iranian ports in the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman. The blockage severely restricted Iran's crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz and the Arabian Sea.The CENTCOM claimed that in recent months, "America's naval blockade has prevented Iran from exporting more than $25 billion in crude oil." It said, "Strict enforcement at sea continues against all ships entering or departing Iranian ports."The naval blockade was initially imposed on April 13, 2026. Since the US and Israel began attacks on Iran in February 2026, Tehran sought the upper hand by hitting vessels in the Strait of Hormuz to block Gulf energy exports, while US forces began blockading movements to and from Iranian ports in April.As part of the blockade, US forces have actively targeted and disabled cargo ships attempting to breach the restrictions.Highlighting Iran's spiralling economy, Trump said, "They are not paying their soldiers; they are not paying their guards. They have 301 percent inflation. They have no money, they are not doing well, and at some point, they are going to be reasonable.""I can go in and blow them up right now. The problem with that is you'll never be able to rebuild it. If I blow up bridges...it would take 10-12-15 years to rebuild...that'll put awfully bog burden on people," Trump said.The campaign, first reported by Reuters on Saturday, will crack down on Tehran's movement of advanced weapons and other sanctioned material over its land borders and through the Caspian Sea.Iran's nuclear proposalIran has submitted a nuclear proposal to Washington through Qatar, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Thursday, saying the US was reviewing it but discussions would depend on Washington first meeting Tehran's seven demands.These include sanctions relief, access to frozen assets and war reparations, while Washington says nuclear issues must feature in initial talks.Speaking during a commemorative event, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Aerospace Force spokesperson Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi outlined three strategic pillars driving the force's rapid expansion: indigenous scientific localisation, domestic industrial mass-production, and absolute self-sufficiency.Mohebbi asserted that domestic technological breakthroughs have allowed Tehran to meet its internal military requirements while supplying international markets with advanced equipment, citing the domestically developed Arman missile, the 358 loitering drone, and the Khordad-3 surface-to-air missile defence system."This development served as the catalyst for sweeping changes... transforming us from an importer of military weaponry into an exporter in the aerospace sector," Mohebbi was quoted as saying by Mehr News Agency.The developments highlight the contrasting positions, with CENTCOM announcing measures to restrict the movement of Iranian military-related materials and the IRGC Aerospace Force publicly emphasising its domestic production capabilities and defence exports.(With inputs from agencies)

[東京 ９日 ロイター] -  商船三井が９日発表した２０２７年３月期の中間期（２６年４－９月）の連結純利益は前年比５４．３％増の１７９３億円だった。また、１２月３１日を基準日に２７年１月１日付で１対３の株式分割を実施すると発表した。 

発行済み株式の２．６２％に当たる９００万株・５００億円を上限とする自社株買いを決議したことも発表した。取得期間は１０日から２７年３月３１日まで。取得する自社株は原則として消却する予定。

通期の連結純利益予想は今月２日、従来の２４００億円から前年比４０．６％増の３０００億円へ上方修正している。９日時点のＩＢＥＳがまとめたアナリスト１１人の予想平均値は２９７１億円。

items.title: Qué puede cambiar para el bolsillo de los estadounidenses tras la victoria demócrata en el Congreso
items.author: Suzanne Woolley, Zijia Song, Prashant Gopal
items.summary: La victoria demócrata en el Congreso podría tener efectos en los impuestos, la jubilación, las inversiones y el mercado inmobiliario. Sin embargo, el alcance de los cambios dependerá de las facultades ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los estadounidenses otorgaron a los demócratas una contundente victoria en las elecciones de mitad de legislatura el martes y, con ella, un mandato para resolver sus problemas económicos. En una encuesta tras otra, los votantes expresaron su descontento por la situación de la economía estadounidense, especialmente por el costo de productos básicos como los alimentos, la gasolina y la vivienda. Muchos votantes esperan ahora que sus líderes recién elegidos tomen medidas para reducir el costo de la vida y les ayuden a ahorrar. Pero rara vez es tan sencillo. El Congreso no puede controlar los mercados ni el crecimiento del PIB, y mucho menos los precios de la gasolina y los alimentos. Y aunque los candidatos se han comprometido a hacer frente a los aranceles y a la guerra con Irán, gran parte de ello sigue estando bajo el control del presidente Donald Trump. Ver más: La victoria arrolladora de los demócratas pone a prueba las operaciones vinculadas a Trump en toda América Latina No obstante, las elecciones son importantes, y los resultados podrían tener consecuencias a largo plazo en ámbitos como los impuestos, las pensiones, la regulación de la inteligencia artificial y otros. A continuación le explicamos lo que el cambio de poder en el Congreso podría significar para su situación financiera personal. El logro económico más destacado de Trump fue la aprobación, el año pasado, de la Ley ‘ One Big Beautiful Bill ’ (OBBBA). Los demócratas no podrán derogar las principales disposiciones de la ley, como los recortes fiscales para las rentas más altas, ya que Trump tiene poder de veto sobre la legislación. Podrían actuar para prorrogar algunas de las disposiciones temporales de la OBBBA que les resulten favorables, según Alvina Lo, directora de asesoramiento, planificación y servicios fiduciarios de BNY Wealth. Entre esas disposiciones temporales se incluyen deducciones por una parte de las horas extras y de los ingresos por propinas, así como una deducción adicional para los contribuyentes de 65 años o más. También está sobre la mesa la situación de la deducción por impuestos estatales y locales (SALT), que está previsto que vuelva de su límite actual de US$40.000 a su nivel anterior de US$10.000 a finales de 2029. Algunos demócratas de estados con una elevada presión fiscal, como Nueva York y Nueva Jersey, han pedido que se elimine por completo el límite máximo de la deducción SALT. Algunos resultados estatales y locales también pueden tener repercusiones a nivel nacional. En California, los votantes parecían encaminados a rechazar un impuesto sobre el patrimonio de los multimillonarios y aprobaron una medida que convierte en permanente una tasa impositiva marginal más elevada. Esto sugiere que es poco probable que se apruebe un impuesto general sobre el patrimonio como el propuesto por la senadora de Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren y otros, señaló Lo, aunque a nivel estatal existe un interés por aumentar las tasas impositivas marginales. Esas medidas podrían dar a los estadounidenses acaudalados motivos continuos para abandonar los estados con impuestos elevados. Quienes no puedan trasladarse probablemente seguirán constituyendo fideicomisos en estados considerados fiscalmente favorables, como Delaware y Nevada, para reducir su impuesto sobre la renta estatal, afirmó Lo. Ver más: Del malestar económico al avance demócrata en bastiones republicanos: qué pasó en las elecciones de EE.UU. El futuro financiero de la Seguridad Social se cierne sobre Washington. Las elecciones no aportan una solución, pero refuerzan la posición de los demócratas a la hora de dar forma a una. Muchos demócratas desean sentar unas bases más sólidas para el programa recaudando más ingresos de las personas con rentas elevadas (es decir, gravándolas), en lugar de recortar las prestaciones. Es probable que un Congreso liderado por los demócratas impulse medidas para ampliar el número de personas cubiertas por planes de jubilación. El diputado Richard Neal, demócrata de Massachusetts y uno de los principales promotores de la Ley Secure 2.0 de 2022, el último proyecto de ley importante sobre jubilación aprobado por el Congreso, está llamado a retomar las riendas de la Comisión de Medios y Arbitrios de la Cámara de Representantes, uno de los poderosos órganos con competencia en materia de planes de jubilación. Entre los posibles temas a tratar figuran: ampliar la inscripción automática en los planes de jubilación, aumentar la elegibilidad para acceder a dichos planes entre los trabajadores a tiempo parcial y los trabajadores temporales, y, posiblemente, crear una cuenta de jubilación federal para las personas que no tengan acceso a un plan de jubilación en el ámbito laboral. El control demócrata del Congreso también supondrá una mayor influencia en la supervisión del Departamento de Trabajo, del que depende la agencia que regula los planes de jubilación en el ámbito laboral, los seguros médicos y otras prestaciones para los empleados. Esto podría traducirse en un mayor énfasis en reforzar la protección de los participantes y en un menor énfasis en facilitar las inversiones alternativas en planes como los 401(k). Independientemente del resultado de las elecciones, los asesores financieros desaconsejan dejar que las emociones impulsen los cambios en la cartera. “Cuando el partido o el candidato de alguien pierde, el futuro puede parecer más arriesgado de lo que es, y el miedo impulsa decisiones importantes: pasar a efectivo, solicitar la Seguridad Social antes de tiempo o abandonar un plan”, afirmó Eileen Olson, fundadora de Emerald Wealth. “Pero los grandes cambios llevan tiempo, requieren legislación o, a menudo, se introducen de forma gradual o se les aplica una cláusula de exención, por lo que suele haber tiempo para adaptarse”. Ver más: Demócratas toman el control del Congreso de EE.UU. y ponen a Wall Street bajo presión A los mercados les suele gustar un gobierno dividido; el S&P 500 subió un 1,6% el miércoles, ya que los inversores acogieron con agrado la perspectiva de una división entre el Congreso y la Casa Blanca. La historia sugiere que ese optimismo está justificado. Desde 1950, el S&P 500 ha generado rendimientos positivos en los 12 meses posteriores a cada elección de mitad de legislatura, independientemente del partido que ganara. Donde los inversores podrían notar una diferencia mayor es en sectores concretos, especialmente en el de la inteligencia artificial. La construcción de centros de datos podría estar sujeta a una mayor supervisión a medida que los demócratas asuman el control en los estados y en Washington. Una supervisión más estricta no significa que todas las acciones relacionadas con la IA vayan a salir perdiendo, según Omar Qureshi, director general de Hightower Signature Wealth. Las empresas cuya suerte depende en gran medida de la construcción de más centros de datos, incluidos los fabricantes de semiconductores, los proveedores de equipos eléctricos y los proveedores de ‘neocloud’, que alquilan capacidad informática para IA, podrían enfrentarse a una mayor presión. Los centros de datos existentes que cuenten con capacidad energética garantizada podrían ganar valor a medida que resulte más difícil llevar a cabo nuevos proyectos. Qureshi también prevé un posible giro hacia empresas tecnológicas consolidadas, como Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ) y Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ), que pueden obtener beneficios de la IA sin depender exclusivamente de una expansión cada vez más rápida de la infraestructura. En el ámbito sanitario, los esfuerzos demócratas por proteger Medicaid y restablecer las ayudas de la Ley de Asistencia Asequible podrían beneficiar a los gestores hospitalarios al aumentar el número de pacientes asegurados, mientras que la renovada presión para reducir los precios de los medicamentos y endurecer las normas de Medicare Advantage podría lastrar a los fabricantes de medicamentos y a las aseguradoras, según afirmó Lale Akoner, estratega de mercados globales de eToro. Los precios de la gasolina se dispararon por encima de los US$4 el galón después de que EE.UU. entrara en guerra con Irán y se han mantenido en gran medida en ese nivel, lo que ha contribuido a impulsar al alza la inflación general. Las elecciones supusieron un alivio inmediato en los mercados petroleros, y el crudo Brent se desplomó casi un 9% el miércoles, ya que los inversores apostaron por que la victoria arrolladora de los demócratas aumentaría la presión sobre Washington para poner fin al conflicto. El propio vicepresidente JD Vance achacó las derrotas de los republicanos a la guerra, afirmando que los votantes querían que esta terminara. Los demócratas no pueden poner fin a la guerra por sí solos, pero pueden oponerse a la solicitud presupuestaria de la Casa Blanca de US$1,5 billones para el Pentágono y proponer un comité de supervisión encargado de llevar a cabo investigaciones sobre la guerra con Irán. Los precios de la gasolina comenzaron a bajar ligeramente antes de las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. El precio medio nacional de la gasolina bajó 12 céntimos con respecto a la semana pasada, hasta situarse en US$4,12 por galón, según GasBuddy, una aplicación para ahorrar en combustible. Patrick De Haan, responsable de análisis petrolero de GasBuddy, afirmó en una publicación en redes sociales que podría caer por debajo de los US$4 en el plazo de una semana. Otros gastos domésticos también se mantienen elevados. Los precios al consumo subieron un 3,7% en septiembre con respecto al año anterior, frente al 3,4% registrado en agosto. Los demócratas podrían cuestionar las políticas comerciales de Trump, ya que los aranceles son otro importante factor de inflación. Revocar los aranceles mediante medidas legislativas podría resultar complicado, dado que Trump cuenta con derecho de veto. Matt Lloyd, estratega jefe de inversiones de Advisors Asset Management, prevé que los precios se mantengan elevados y señaló que los precios de los alimentos también podrían mostrar volatilidad debido al efecto de El Niño sobre las condiciones meteorológicas y las cosechas. Ver más: Victoria demócrata en el Congreso refuerza la calificación crediticia de EE.UU., según Scope Ratings Los demócratas convirtieron la vivienda en un poderoso grito de guerra de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. Sus nuevas mayorías en ambas cámaras del Congreso les otorgarán más poder para reformar la política federal de vivienda. Sin embargo, no pueden controlar las tasas hipotecarias, que actualmente superan el 7% y constituyen el mayor obstáculo para mejorar la asequibilidad a corto plazo. Algunas de las principales palancas para aliviar la crisis de la vivienda están en manos de Trump. Su administración podría intentar poner fin a la guerra, que está avivando los temores inflacionistas que mantienen altas las tasas, y revocar los aranceles impuestos mediante medidas ejecutivas. Las agresivas políticas de inmigración de la administración también están ejerciendo presión sobre los constructores, que dependen en gran medida de trabajadores de la construcción nacidos en el extranjero, según afirmó Mark Zandi, economista jefe de Moody’s Analytics. “La forma más directa de aliviar la crisis de la asequibilidad de la vivienda es poner fin a la guerra”, afirmó Zandi. “No existe una solución infalible ni una política que garantice el éxito y que vaya a resolver el problema”. El Congreso aprobó su amplia Ley ’21st Century Road to Housing’, diseñada para aumentar la oferta de viviendas, pero tardará años en dar sus frutos. Las propuestas de ayuda para la entrada inicial que han planteado algunos demócratas aumentarían la demanda, lo que a su vez podría hacer subir los precios en mercados donde la oferta es limitada. Sin embargo, lo que el país necesita son más viviendas de nueva construcción que sean más asequibles, y eso requerirá tiempo y políticas inteligentes, afirmó Susan Wachter, profesora de el sector inmobiliario en la Wharton School de la Universidad de Pensilvania. “Necesitamos una acción colectiva en todos los niveles de gobierno para encontrar una solución”, afirmó. “Necesitamos que bajen las tasas hipotecarias y que haya viviendas de primera adquisición más asequibles”. En Florida, los votantes aprobaron recortes generalizados del impuesto sobre bienes inmuebles que entrarán en vigor el 1 de enero. Para 2028, los primeros US$250.000 del valor catastral de una vivienda quedarán exentos de la mayoría de los impuestos sobre bienes inmuebles. El estado ya no aplica el impuesto sobre la renta. items.title: 焦点：北朝鮮、厚遇で育てる精鋭ハッカー　バイナンス事件関与か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Heejin Kim　Kyu-seok Shim　Maggie Grether　Brenda Goh

[ソウル ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Heejin Kim　Kyu-seok Shim　Maggie Grether　Brenda Goh

[ソウル ６日 ロイター] - 暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業大手のバイナンスが６３億ドル相当のハッキング被害を受けた事件について米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）は、北朝鮮のハッカー集団が関与したとの見方を示している。ブロックチェーン調査会社は、北朝鮮のハッカー集団「トレーダートレイター」による犯行と分析している。

北朝鮮は関与を否定しているものの、同国はこのような任務を担うトップハッカーらに首都平壌の広々とした集合住宅の部屋や、巨額の外貨報酬といった特典を与えている。

脱北者やアナリストらによると、金正恩・朝鮮労働党総書記はこうした報奨制度を活用して世界トップクラスのハッカー集団を編成してきた。１０年以上前から続いている制度では、毎年最も優秀な中学生２００人を選抜してコンピュータ工学を学ばせている。その一部は最終的にハッカーとなる。

２００４年に韓国へ亡命するまで国からハッカー養成を担当していた脱北者の金興光氏は「彼らは実際、金正恩氏の秘密兵器の一つだ」とし、「これほど体系的に、最も優秀な子どもたちを探し出し、もっぱら工作員に育て上げるためにハッカーを育成している国は他にない」と説明。その上で「彼らがハッカーになりたいかどうかは問題ではない」と述べた。

＜体系的な選抜＞

北朝鮮は１９９８年にサイバー部隊を設立したが、金正恩氏が権力を掌握した後、その地位を格上げした。２０１３年にはサイバー戦争を、核兵器やミサイルと並んで同国の攻撃能力にとって不可欠な「万能の剣」だと宣言した。

金興光氏と、ＩＴ分野で働いていた脱北者２人によると、候補者の選抜は中学時代の早ければ１１歳または１２歳に始まり、当局は毎年１５０―２００人程度の子どもを選抜してコンピュータ科学を学ばせている。

１７歳になると、成績上位者は北朝鮮でトップの大学に送られ、さらに選び抜かれたごく一部のメンバーだけが軍のサイバー部隊にハッカーとして入隊するという。

１人の脱北者によると、彼らは高度な数学や外国語といった一般的な科目に加え、暗号資産のプロトコルや外国製ハードウエアのリバースエンジニアリング（分解調査）などの分野の訓練も受けている。

ハッカーにならなかったメンバーは、リモートワークを通じて欧米企業向けのソフトウエアやアプリを開発できるよう訓練される。

高麗大サイバーセキュリティ学部の林鍾仁名誉教授は「韓国の優秀な学生は医師など社会的地位の高い職業を目指すかもしれないが、北朝鮮はトップクラスの人材を核・サイバープログラムに投入し、彼らの将来を事実上保証している」と指摘する。

ハッカーらに与えられる他の特典としては、中国などの同盟国への海外渡航があり、そこではより自由にインターネットにアクセスできる。

金興光氏によると、サイバー攻撃に成功したハッカーが所属する軍事部隊には、盗み出した利益の最大で３０％が米ドルで還元される。ハッカー自身は平壌に集合住宅の部屋を支給され、両親もそこに滞在できるようになる。

高麗大の林氏は「サイバー作戦に成功したハッカーには、平壌の集合住宅の部屋が支給されるという報告がある」とし、部屋の広さは最大で１３２平方メートルに及ぶ可能性があると説明した。

脱北者の１人は、こうした優秀なハッカーは朝鮮労働党への入党資格を得たり、エリート層家庭出身者との結婚を許されたりすることもあると証言した。

ただ、こうした特典を得られるのはごく一部に限られる。韓国国家情報院の２４年の推計によると、北朝鮮のサイバー戦争に従事する人員は約８４００人に上っている。

北朝鮮の国営メディアは、こうしたハッカーらの功績を公に称えることはない。一方で、プログラミングの才能を見せた学生については定期的に伝えている。

北朝鮮は１５年、平壌に「未来科学者通り」を開通させた。国営メディアによると、敷設には金正恩氏が深く関与していた。

脱北者の１人によると、北朝鮮でのハッカーの正式な肩書きは「科学者」または「研究者」となっている。

＜北朝鮮の優位性＞

北朝鮮系の他のハッカー集団には、「ラザルスグループ」（別名ＡＰＴ３８）がある。米国は２０２２年、ラザルスがブロックチェーンのネットワーク「ロニン・ネットワーク」から数億ドル相当の暗号資産を盗んだと非難した。ＦＢＩはハッカー集団「トレーダートレイター」がラザルスと関連があると指摘している。

アナリストらは、国家の後ろ盾があることで北朝鮮のハッカーはより危険な存在となり、撃退も困難になると警告している。彼らは度重なるハッキング行為に対して何の罰も受けないため、戦略を磨き上げることができるという特色を持つ。

ブロックチェーン分析企業チェイナリシスのアジア太平洋地域グローバルサービス担当シニアマネージャー、アレック・ゼブリック氏は「サイバー犯罪の世界では多くの場合、一度でもミスを犯せばそれだけで法執行機関に捕まってしまうことが多い」としながらも、北朝鮮のハッカーらは「体制のために活動しているため、成功後も活動を続けるだろう。失敗しても活動を続ける。国際社会が彼らに対して措置を取ることは極めて難しいからだ」と述べた。

西側諸国の企業のリモート技術職に就き、北朝鮮の外貨稼ぎの一翼を担っている同国のＩＴ労働者と関わってきた組織は、彼らについて組織化が進んでおり、接し方が礼儀正しく、人工知能（ＡＩ）を積極的に活用していると評する。

北朝鮮のＩＴ労働者の勤務状況を監視するカメラへのハッキングに成功したと主張するユーチューバー、Deeveeaar氏は「明らかに軍隊に見られるような組織構造があった。厳格な時間管理で、ブーツの手入れも非常に整然としていた」とし、「彼らが『ＡＩを多用している』というのは控えめな表現だ。ＡＩこそが彼らの活動の根幹そのものだ」として米オープンＡＩの生成ＡＩモデル「チャットＧＰＴ」の有料アカウントや、アンソロピックの「クロード・コード」、ＡＩコーディングツール「カーソル」などの多くのＡＩツールの利用例を挙げた。

その上で「彼らはそれを使ってコードを書き、履歴書を改ざんしたり、新しい履歴書を作成したりしている。さらには、文書や身元を偽造することさえある」と解説した。

バイナンスによると、サイバー攻撃を手がけたハッカーらは偽の就職面接や、広告に隠されたソフトウエアを利用して従業員のコンピューターを乗っ取り、その後内部のＡＩツールを使ってシステムの制御権を掌握した。

国連加盟１１カ国で構成される北朝鮮制裁の監視チームは、トレーダートレイターがチャットＧＰＴと、中国の新興企業ディープシークが開発したＡＩモデルの両方のアカウントを入手していたと発表した。

＜過酷な労働環境＞

しかし、北朝鮮の元ＩＴ労働者や人権団体によると、北朝鮮のハッカーやエリート技術者らの生活は特に任務を課せられたり、外国に派遣されたりする場合には極めて過酷だ。

非営利団体（ＮＰＯ）のＰＳＣＯＲＥが昨年作成した報告書のために取材を受けた北朝鮮の元ＩＴ労働者らは、狭い空間での生活や１日１０時間を超える長時間労働、絶え間ない監視、厳しいノルマなどの実態を証言した。

ＰＳＣＯＲＥのナム・バダ事務局長は「彼らには常に金を稼ぎ続けなければならないというプレッシャーがある」とし、「ストレスは極限に達しており、心理的な負担のせいで健康上の問題を抱えるようになる人々もいる」と紹介。さらに、ドル建ての月間ノルマを達成しなければならず、達成できなければ屈辱的な扱いを受けるなどの罰に直面すると説明した。

それでもアナリストらは、ハッカーらの成功は、彼らの技術が向上し、野心が高まるにつれて、金正恩氏をさらに大胆にさせる可能性が高いとの見方を示す。

チェイナリシスのゼブリック氏は「いわゆる『ビッグゲーム・ハンティング』に傾倒する者がますます増えている」とし、「つまり彼らはより大規模な組織、つまり潜在的に巨額の資金を保有している可能性のある組織を標的にしている。これらはより攻略が難しい標的だ」と解説してこう訴えた。

「しかし、バイナンスの事件からもわかるように、得られる報酬は、彼らが労力を費やすに値することが明らかだ」

items.title: Sheikh Hasina seeks new passport ahead of December return to Bangladesh as government doubles down on extradition
items.author: Bobins Vayalil Abraham
items.summary: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has requested a new passport and national identity card ahead of a planned return. Bangladesh says it has sought her extradition from India under the treaty, following her conviction and death sentence for crimes against humanity.
items.body:
Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has reportedly requested for a new passport and identity card ahead of her previously announced return to her home country in December. According to Reuters, Hasina, who has been living in self-imposed exile in India since fleeing Bangladesh in August 2024, made the request for new documents on Monday.
"In view of the reported revocation of her existing Bangladeshi passport and National Identity Card (NID) by the Interim Government and other authorities, I respectfully request that you take the necessary steps to issue a new Bangladeshi passport and National Identity Card for our client," Hasina's lawyers at London-based Matrix Chambers wrote to Preeti Rahman, acting high commissioner at Bangladesh's embassy in Delhi, Reuters reported.
The letter asked for the applications to be processed "expeditiously" on the basis of her Bangladeshi nationality and in accordance with "obligations arising under international human rights instruments".
Sheikh Hasina to return to Bangladesh
In July, Hasina, who is facing a death sentence, had made her intention to return to the country she ruled for nearly two decades. While no date has been formally set, Hasina’s aides told Reuters on Monday that it will be announced once various formalities are completed.
Earlier, on Sunday, Bangladesh’s Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman reiterated his country's demand that ‘convicted criminal’ Hasina should be extradited, and added that the extradition request is already with New Delhi.
"To me, she is a criminal. A criminal convicted by our tribunal. To us, this is her identity," he said, according to a report on bdnews24.
Asked about bringing Hasina back to Bangladesh, the law minister said the government would act in accordance with the law and would not be guided by emotion.
"Although the Law Ministry is not directly involved in this matter, the Ministry of Home Affairs is concerned, as it relates to the extradition treaty with India. The matter will be dealt with in accordance with the law, leaving no room for emotions. We have requested her repatriation under the treaty and through due process," Asaduzzaman was quoted as saying by the state-run BSS news agency.Sheikh Hasina faces death penaltyIn November 2025, the International Crimes Tribunal convicted her of crimes against humanity. The charges relate to the July and August 2024 uprising. The tribunal sentenced her to death.Her party, the Awami League, was the country's largest before it was banned following her fall. Many of her party colleagues have either been jailed or are in self-imposed exile in India or elsewhere.

items.title: 中国、米国関連船への特別港湾料徴収停止を延長　27年1月まで
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［北京　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［北京　９日　ロイター］ - 中国交通運輸省は９日、米国関連の船舶に対する特別港湾料徴収停止措置を２０２７年１月１０日まで延長したと発表した。

声明によると、海運および造船のサプライチェーン（供給網）の安全保障関連調査の停止も継続する。

同省は２０２５年１１月１０日、特別港湾料徴収を１年間停止すると発表した。同年１０月の米中首脳の合意に基づき、米国も中国の海運・造船業界を対象とする制裁措置を停止したことを受けた措置。

items.title: G7 allies to assess impact of Trump's midterm setback at Paris talks
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The meeting in Paris on Monday (Nov 9) will also see US Secretary of State Marco Rubio make his first appearance before allies since the elections.

G7 allies to assess impact of Trump's midterm setback at Paris talks

The meeting in Paris on Monday (Nov 9) will also see US Secretary of State Marco Rubio make his first appearance before allies since the elections.

The logo of the G7 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors' meeting is displayed at Niigata station in Niigata, Japan, May 10, 2023. REUTERS/Issei Kato

PARIS: A G7 foreign ministers gathering in Paris on Monday (Nov 9) will provide the first opportunity for Washington's allies to gauge whether a US midterm defeat for President Donald Trump alters the administration's approach to Ukraine, the Middle East and ties with its closest partners, four G7 diplomats said.
The diplomats signalled the Democrats' gains could narrow the White House's room for manoeuvre but warned against expecting a return to traditional US multilateralism while foreign policy remains very much under Trump's control.
The meeting, moved at short notice from Marseille to Paris for security reasons after weeks of protests across France , will see US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, viewed as a potential 2028 presidential contender, make his first appearance before allies since the elections.
Other than France, the G7 includes Britain, Canada, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States, as well as the European Union. Ministers from Ukraine, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Korea and Brazil are also attending.

With Ukraine top of the agenda, the G7 ministerial comes ahead of trilateral discussions on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi between Ukraine, Russia and the United States. 
Officials from France, Britain, Germany, NATO and the European Commission are also aiming to be in the Emirati capital, although they are not expected to take part in the trilateral format.

Related:

Commentary: Which G7 economy is the poster child for debt woes?

G7 to launch exercises to guard against AI cyber attacks

In a sign of friction among Europeans, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned on Nov 5 that Europe risks becoming irrelevant in efforts to end the war in Ukraine if member states continue pursuing separate diplomatic tracks rather than agreeing on a common representative and strategy, an issue that is likely to come up at the G7.
Diplomats painted a sombre picture of the situation in Ukraine. While the front had largely stabilised, making major breakthroughs unlikely, they warned that Russia had shifted tactics toward systematically targeting energy infrastructure in an effort to trigger a nationwide winter blackout.
Shortages of Patriot interceptors and other air-defence systems were Kyiv's most urgent military vulnerability and they said one objective of the G7 meeting would be to sustain pressure on Russia while mobilising additional military, financial and energy support for Ukraine.
Iran is also expected to feature prominently in discussions. Washington's G7 allies have repeatedly voiced scepticism over the war and fear further US military action could worsen rather than resolve the crisis.
The talks could also expose differences between Paris and Washington over Lebanon.
France is pushing for discussions on a new UN-backed security framework to replace current arrangements in southern Lebanon and has floated options including a French-Italian international force.
While French officials privately acknowledge US reluctance to embrace some of those ideas, diplomats said the G7 offers an opportunity for the allies to narrow differences as the expiry of existing arrangements at the end of the year draws nearer.

Source: Reuters/ht

PARIS: A G7 foreign ministers gathering in Paris on Monday (Nov 9) will provide the first opportunity for Washington's allies to gauge whether a US midterm defeat for President Donald Trump alters the administration's approach to Ukraine, the Middle East and ties with its closest partners, four G7 diplomats said.
The diplomats signalled the Democrats' gains could narrow the White House's room for manoeuvre but warned against expecting a return to traditional US multilateralism while foreign policy remains very much under Trump's control.
The meeting, moved at short notice from Marseille to Paris for security reasons after weeks of protests across France , will see US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, viewed as a potential 2028 presidential contender, make his first appearance before allies since the elections.
Other than France, the G7 includes Britain, Canada, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States, as well as the European Union. Ministers from Ukraine, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Korea and Brazil are also attending.

With Ukraine top of the agenda, the G7 ministerial comes ahead of trilateral discussions on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi between Ukraine, Russia and the United States. 
Officials from France, Britain, Germany, NATO and the European Commission are also aiming to be in the Emirati capital, although they are not expected to take part in the trilateral format.

Related:

Commentary: Which G7 economy is the poster child for debt woes?

G7 to launch exercises to guard against AI cyber attacks

In a sign of friction among Europeans, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned on Nov 5 that Europe risks becoming irrelevant in efforts to end the war in Ukraine if member states continue pursuing separate diplomatic tracks rather than agreeing on a common representative and strategy, an issue that is likely to come up at the G7.
Diplomats painted a sombre picture of the situation in Ukraine. While the front had largely stabilised, making major breakthroughs unlikely, they warned that Russia had shifted tactics toward systematically targeting energy infrastructure in an effort to trigger a nationwide winter blackout.
Shortages of Patriot interceptors and other air-defence systems were Kyiv's most urgent military vulnerability and they said one objective of the G7 meeting would be to sustain pressure on Russia while mobilising additional military, financial and energy support for Ukraine.
Iran is also expected to feature prominently in discussions. Washington's G7 allies have repeatedly voiced scepticism over the war and fear further US military action could worsen rather than resolve the crisis.
The talks could also expose differences between Paris and Washington over Lebanon.
France is pushing for discussions on a new UN-backed security framework to replace current arrangements in southern Lebanon and has floated options including a French-Italian international force.
While French officials privately acknowledge US reluctance to embrace some of those ideas, diplomats said the G7 offers an opportunity for the allies to narrow differences as the expiry of existing arrangements at the end of the year draws nearer.

Source: Reuters/ht

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［北京　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［北京　９日　ロイター］ - 中国北部の山西省太原市にある高層ビルで８日に火災が発生し、１４人が死亡した。国営新華社通信が９日、伝えた。

国営メディアによると、火災は現地時間８日午後４時５９分（日本時間午後５時５９分）、太原市中心部にあるビルで発生した。

火は約２時間後に消し止められた。当局によると、午後８時半までに救助活動が終了し、３８人が病院に搬送された。８日深夜までに５人の死亡が確認されていた。

国営メディアが９日伝えたところによると、出火原因は調査中という。

Nov 9 : World number three Carlos Alcaraz said his Paris Masters victory on Sunday was the ideal platform to launch his campaign for a first ATP Finals title and that he had played his best tennis since returning from a wrist injury in August.
Alcaraz defeated American Ben Shelton 7-6(5) 7-5 in Paris to seal his fifth title of the year and his third since returning to the tour at the US Open after a break of nearly five months.
"This was probably my best week in terms of tennis (since returning)," the seven-time Grand Slam champion told reporters.
"I can match it with Vienna, that I feel really comfortable in terms of tennis.

"But I would say this week, I made one step forward mentally. I had a lot of really tough moments.
"During the matches, I faced important and really tough moments internally, fighting with myself, trying to be positive, trying to stay strong mentally, and not letting those negative thoughts into the game."
Alcaraz has yet to win the ATP Tour's season-ending tournament, finishing runner-up in 2025 after losing to rival Jannik Sinner.
"As I said openly, this is a tournament that I really want to win one day," Alcaraz said.
"I don't know if it's going be this year, next year, if I'm ever going be able to win this tournament, but I'm going to work hard.
"I'm going to believe that I can do that, and I'm going to go this year with a lot of confidence, with a lot of information in my bag, on the things that I really want to improve and be better at in that tournament. I'm going to go for it, for sure."

items.title: 焦点：バンス氏、次期大統領選に向け戦略再構築　トランプ氏との距離感が課題
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - 米中間選挙の終盤、共和党の退潮を食い止めようと、バンス副大統領（４２）は戦略を転換した。トランプ大統領についての言及を減らし、自らの政治姿勢を特徴付ける政策課題について、より多く語り始めた。

中間選挙に向けた９月の共和党大会以降にバンス氏が行った６回の演説をロイターが検証したところ、ほぼ全てが自らが掲げる政策を軸に、共和党への支持を訴える内容だった。

世論調査が、トランプ氏の支持率低迷が共和党候補者らの足を引っ張っていることを示していた中で、バンス氏はイラン戦争や強制送還といったトランプ氏の代名詞的な政策への言及を避けた。

バンス氏の戦略に詳しい関係者２人によると、この変更は意図的なものだった。バンス氏と側近らは、同氏が主張してきた経済ナショナリズム、抑制的な外交政策、治安維持を、同氏が説得力を持って語れる、政治的な訴求力の強いテーマだと考えていた。トランプ氏がこれらを「ＭＡＧＡ（米国を再び偉大に）」運動の一部として受け入れる一方で、バンス氏はその主導的な論客に浮上していたと、関係者は言う。

この戦略転換からは、共和党の大統領候補指名争いに向けてバンス氏がどのように独自の道を切り開いていくかが垣間見える。

バンス氏は２０２８年の大統領選に出馬するかどうかを表明しておらず、トランプ氏も同氏を含め誰も推薦していない。しかしバンス氏は有力候補と見なされており、一部の共和党幹部は、同氏はトランプ氏の支持基盤の多くを継承しつつも、その負の遺産と一線を画す必要があると語る。

バンス氏は４日、異例なほど率直な選挙総括を行い、自身の政治的ブランドを強化するための一歩を踏み出した。同氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、共和党惨敗の原因として対イラン戦争を挙げ、党勢立て直しに向けた基本方針を示した。

紛争の迅速な終結を呼びかけ、共和党は物価高や生活費の問題に注力し、外交関係を再評価し、米国とイスラエルとの関係も見直すべきだと訴えた。

＜戦争終結を公然と支持＞

この投稿によって、バンス氏は初めて公然と戦争終結を支持した。

ホワイトハウスとバンス氏の広報に詳しい関係者３人がロイターに語ったところでは、バンス氏はトランプ氏と決裂してはおらず、ホワイトハウスのワイルズ首席補佐官はバンス氏の投稿を事前に把握していた。

トランプ氏が事前に投稿を把握していたかについて、ロイターは確認できなかった。

大統領の長男であるドナルド・トランプ・ジュニア氏は、一部の保守派仲間とともに、ＳＮＳ上でバンス氏の主張を支持した。

共和党の参謀マイケル・リッチ氏は、このやりとりがトランプ氏後の保守派代表としてのバンス氏の存在感をさらに高めたと言う。

＜副大統領というメガホン＞

リッチ氏によると、バンス氏のメッセージによって保守派は、戦争の是非、さらには２８年の共和党大統領候補が受け入れるべき核心的原則について議論せざるを得なくなった。

「バンス氏がトランプ氏との差別化を図っている、という見方は単純過ぎる。これは、彼が副大統領というメガホンを利用して議論の土台を設定しているという話なのだ」という。

バンス氏の代表者はコメントを控えた。

民主党側は、２８年大統領選でバンス氏を含む共和党候補をトランプ氏と結びつける構えで、トランプ氏が候補者選びに大きく関与すれば、民主党は両者の結び付きを一段と強調するとみられる。

民主党の参謀イゴール・ボルスキー氏は「（トランプ氏に）忠誠を見せながら予備選で勝利し、本選で勝てる候補としていかに自らを位置づけるかが大きな課題となる」と語る。

中間選挙でバンス氏のブランドが傷つかなかったわけではない。同氏が応援演説を行った州で共和党は敗北した。また同氏が支持した選挙戦略の幾つかは、共和党に不利に働いた可能性がある。

他の潜在的な大統領選候補者たちも、中間選挙の敗北に関する独自の分析を示している。テキサス州選出のテッド・クルーズ上院議員は、共和党が生活費の問題に対して十分な取り組みを行わなかったと述べた。フロリダ州のデサンティス知事は、敗北した候補者らがトランスジェンダーの問題に過剰に集中し、データセンターや人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る有権者の懸念を軽視したと述べた。ルビオ国務長官は沈黙を守っている。

議論の方向性を形作ろうとするバンス氏の取り組みは、選挙戦の終盤に顕著だった。

演説で同氏は有権者に対し、共和党が連邦の医療費や貧困対策プログラムにおける不正を調査し、移民や生活費対策に関連付けていくと訴え、党への支持を呼びかけた。対イラン戦争やガソリン価格には一切と言っていいほど触れず、トランプ氏の名も滅多に口にしなかった。

ノースカロライナ州の集会では「私は自分の子供たちが、活気に満ち、繁栄し、自由で豊かな国で家族を育てることを望んでいる。望むのはシンプルな事だ。自分自身のためにそれを望むからこそ、皆様のためにも望むのだ」と訴えた。

items.title: アンソロピック、発電機確保へ34億ドル契約　データセンター向け＝ＦＴ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［８日　ロイター］ - 人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業アンソロピックが、データセンター向けのガス火力発電機を確保するため、約３４億ドルの契約を結んだ。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が８日報じた。

報道によると、アンソロピックは９月下旬、米テキサス州サンアントニオに拠点を置く機器供給会社ＯｎｅＰＷＲソリューションズから、総出力１．７ギガワットの大型発電機の供給を受ける権利を購入した。

ＦＴが事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じたところによると、アンソロピックはＯｎｅＰＷＲ自体を買収したわけではなく、従業員の移籍もなかった。ただ、契約には発電機の設置に必要なエンジニアリング・建設の能力も含まれていたという。

ロイターは報道内容を直ちに確認できなかった。アンソロピックとＯｎｅＰＷＲはコメント要請に回答しなかった。

アンソロピックはＡＩモデル「クロード」への旺盛な需要を受け、計算能力と電力供給能力の追加確保を進めている。ロイターは９月、同社が今後１０年間でＡＩインフラ構築に５０００億ドル超を支出する見通しだと報じた。

アンソロピックはＡＩモデル「クロード」への旺盛な需要を受け、計算能力と電力供給能力の追加確保を進めている。ロイターは９月、同社が今後１０年間でＡＩインフラ構築に５０００億ドル超を支出する見通しだと報じた。

items.title: イケア、通期決算は減収減益　売上高は3年連続減少
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Helen Reid

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Helen Reid

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - スウェーデン家具大手イケアの世界全体のフランチャイズとブランドを管理する持ち株会社インター・イケアが６日発表した２０２６年度（２０２５年９月ー２６年８月）通期決算は、売上高が３年連続の減少となった。中東紛争に起因するコスト上昇に加え、価格引き下げ策を講じたにもかかわらず節約志向の消費者からの需要が低迷していることを背景に、苦戦が続いている。

売上高は前年比２％減の４３８億ユーロ（４９０億ドル）となった。純利益は１４億ユーロで、前年の１５億ユーロから減少した。

今年初めに最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に就任したヤクブ・ヤンコフスキ氏は「売上高はここ数年伸び悩んでおり、より多くの人々に手頃な価格の家具を提供するためには、再び成長軌道に戻る必要がある」と述べ、より多くの製品を販売し、生活費の高騰に苦しむ家庭により手頃な価格で商品を提供することが目標だと強調した。

同社は消費者需要の低迷が購入量の減少を招いたほか、サプライヤーと自社製造拠点において生産能力を効率的に活用できない状況をもたらしたと説明。また中東紛争によるエネルギー価格の高騰に伴い、運賃上昇にも直面している。

イケアは郊外にある巨大な青い大型店舗で知られているが、最近では車を使わなくても気軽に立ち寄って商品を購入できる都心部の小規模店舗の展開に重点を移している。

２０２６年度に欧州で１５店舗の小規模店舗を開設したが、消費者需要が振るわない中国では７店舗を閉鎖した。また５月にはコスト削減を図るため、従業員を８５０人削減した。

items.title: スペイン領カナリア諸島、移民流入が急増　州首相「持続不可能」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jesus Cabrera

[ラレスティンガ（スペイン） ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jesus Cabrera

[ラレスティンガ（スペイン） ６日 ロイター] - スペイン領カナリア諸島は11月初週に移民の流入が急増し、海難救助当局は１日からの６日間で３２６１人の移民を救助した。

カナリア諸島自治州のフェルナンド・クラビホ州首相は、移民流入が２０２４年に記録した過去最高水準に迫っており、「日によっては当時を上回るペースになっている」と述べた。西アフリカから欧州への移民流入の主要な玄関口の一つであるカナリア諸島のエルイエロ島（人口約１万１４００人）は、「持続不可能な状況」になっているという。移民の急増で医療や交通サービスにも負担がかかり、他の島から医療スタッフを招集している。

ロイターが撮影した映像には、エルイエロ島のラレスティンガ港に数百人の移民が集まる様子が映っている。スペインの海難救助当局は５日夜、２隻の船から約５００人を救助し、１人の遺体を収容した。

西アフリカからカナリア諸島に至る大西洋ルートは、世界でも特に危険な移民ルートの一つ。毎年、数千人の移民が、荒波や強い海流、長距離の航海という危険を冒し、定員を大幅に超える船に乗ってスペイン領を目指す。このルートを使う移民の数は通常、海況が比較的穏やかになる秋に増加する。

items.title: COP31 to open in Türkiye, with climate goals under pressure from war and AI
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Türkiye's COP31 presidency has centered this year's UN-sponsored summit on a goal to electrify more than a third of the global economy by 2035, up from around a fifth today.

COP31 to open in Türkiye, with climate goals under pressure from war and AI

Türkiye's COP31 presidency has centered this year's UN-sponsored summit on a goal to electrify more than a third of the global economy by 2035, up from around a fifth today.

People walk outside the venue ahead of the United Nations climate change conference, known as COP31, in Antalya, Türkiye on Nov 8, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Murad Sezer)

09 Nov 2026 11:41AM

FAST

ANTALYA, Türkiye: Representatives from nearly 200 countries will gather on Türkiye's Mediterranean coast on Monday (Nov 9) for two weeks of climate talks, as war-driven energy security fears, surging AI power demand and US disengagement put new pressure on the fight against global warming.
The US war with Iran has nations scrambling for oil cargoes and firing up coal plants ; the rapid rollout of AI is pumping up power demand; and the world’s top historic greenhouse gas emitter is shunning climate cooperation for the second year running.
All that has created a challenging backdrop destined to complicate efforts by COP31 host Türkiye to land a strong deal, according to observers. "It's hard to be optimistic," said John Holdren, a professor of environmental policy at Harvard University.
Türkiye's COP31 presidency has centered this year's UN-sponsored summit on a goal to electrify more than a third of the global economy by 2035, up from around a fifth today. It is asking nations to sign onto a pledge supporting that target.

Theoretically, such a goal could help reduce planet-warming emissions by speeding the global shift away from fossil fuel-powered vehicles, furnaces, boilers, cookstoves, and other greenhouse gas-emitting equipment.
But climate advocates have criticised the pledge because it does not require that the additional electricity come from low-carbon sources. This has set up an early fight over whether electrification alone should count as climate progress.
A coalition of countries, including South Pacific island nations most vulnerable to sea level rise, are pushing more generally for a clearer global roadmap away from fossil fuels – a perennially controversial topic at climate summits.
Many oil- and gas-producing nations, including Saudi Arabia, argue that fossil fuels can still form a substantial part of the global energy mix in a climate-friendly world, provided they are paired with technologies that reduce or capture emissions.
Pressure is mounting for faster action on climate change.
A report by the United Nations Environment Programme published in October said the world is already set to overshoot 1.5°C of warming above pre-industrial times, the threshold set at the 2015 Paris climate summit.

Related:

Climate talks will be tougher at COP31 amid heightened global tensions: Grace Fu

World's climate pledges would cut emissions a tenth of what's needed: UN

2026 also stood out with a series of extreme heatwaves across Western Europe and a glacier collapse in Nepal that caused a catastrophic flood that killed more than 1,450 people , with thousands still missing.
"This year has proven to be one of the years with the highest casualties by the climate-induced disasters," said Manjeet Dal, an adviser to the Least Developed Country bloc and south Asia director of Climate Analytics.
WAR AND TECH The Iran war has underscored the world's attachment to fossil fuels, as has Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the ensuing sanctions on Moscow's energy exports. Some say disruptions from the wars have also clarified the benefits of turning to renewables.
The Iran war, now in its ninth month, severely disrupted Middle East oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, lifting fuel prices around the globe and leading governments to scramble for new supplies.
US President Donald Trump's administration has encouraged policies maximizing oil, gas, and coal production to address the Mideast disruptions. South Korea, India, Thailand and other Asian nations, meanwhile, have increased their reliance on coal or taken steps to boost coal-fired power generation.
"A lot of people who previously might have been embarrassed to argue for continuing very high use of fossil fuel are now feeling empowered to make that case," said Holdren of Harvard.

Related:

UN General Assembly: Wars, geopolitical divides, AI and climate change test global cooperation

Commentary: Fossil fuels are winning the battle for easy money

At the same time, the deployment of renewable energy has also risen, driven by surging exports of cheap clean tech from China, cheering advocates for ambitious climate action.
"The war has strengthened the case for accelerating the energy transition. The United States is something of an outlier in this regard," said Andre Correa do Lago, a Brazilian diplomat who presided over last year’s COP.
AI has also added a wrinkle. The technology's rapid rollout is driving a surge in global power demand, contributing to rising greenhouse gas emissions. But its benefits are proving irresistible, even to climate and environment activist groups.
COP31 host Türkiye will call on governments, businesses and other institutions at the conference to sign a pledge outlining principles to ensure AI is developed and deployed sustainably.
Business advocates said they want just one thing from COP31: Clarity.
"Delivery cannot remain a slogan or be left to voluntary initiatives," said John Denton, the secretary general of the International Chamber of Commerce. "COP31 must send clear policy signals that give businesses the confidence to invest in electrification and the wider energy transition — and turn adaptation needs into bankable projects."

Source: Reuters/lk

MELBOURNE, Nov 9 : Australia have dropped Marnus Labuschagne for next month's four-test home series against New Zealand after a prolonged slump in form, selector George Bailey confirmed on Monday.
The 32-year-old number three, once the world's top-ranked test batter, has gone 49 innings without a century and endured another poor tour of South Africa, scoring zero and four in the final test as Australia lost the match and series 2-1.
"At this stage we won't be considering Marnus for selection for certainly that first test, but for the New Zealand series," Bailey told reporters.
"There's been a lot of speculation around his place in the team, and so I think this gives him a little bit of space and clears up a bit of conjecture."

Labuschagne has averaged 23.66 and managed only 2 half-centuries in 10 tests since being dropped for Australia's three-test series against West Indies in the Caribbean last year.
He will return to captain Queensland in the Sheffield Shield while selectors weigh replacements.
Bailey said Labuschagne could still force his way back into the team for next year's tours of India and England.
"It's still possible, absolutely," Bailey said.
"And I think we all know how good and how effective Marnus can be at his best. But that performance hasn't been there."
Labuschagne's omission means another shake-up for an Australian top order which has been in almost constant flux since opener David Warner retired nearly three years ago.  
Steve Smith, who is expected to return for the New Zealand opener in Perth on December 9 after missing the Cape Town test with a neck injury, could bat at number three but has been reluctant to budge from his favoured number four slot since an ill-fated spell as an opener.
All-rounder Cameron Green has previously batted at three at test level while Matt Renshaw could also be considered, though it would mean bringing in another opener.
Australia will finalise their squad following the next round of Shield matches, which begins on Wednesday.
Former test batters Kurtis Patterson and Sam Konstas are among Australia's best top order performers early in the Shield season.

Source: Reuters

items.title: フィリピンＧＤＰ、第3四半期は前年比＋2.1％に鈍化　通年目標達成に暗雲
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mikhail Flores　Nestor Corrales

［マニラ　９日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
Mikhail Flores　Nestor Corrales

［マニラ　９日　ロイター］　 - フィリピンの第３・四半期の経済成長率は５四半期連続で鈍化した。家計消費と政府支出の伸び減速に加え、農業生産の減少が重しとなり、２０２６年通年の成長率は政府目標を下回る公算が大きくなった。

国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は前年同期比２．１％増加した。上方修正された第２・四半期の２．４％増から減速し、約５年ぶりの低水準付近にとどまった。ロイターがまとめた市場予想は３．０％増だった。

季節調整済みの前期比では０．１％増と、第２・四半期の０．６％増から鈍化した。

バリサカン経済企画長官は記者会見で、１─９月の成長率が平均２．５％となったことを踏まえると、政府が掲げる通年成長率目標３．５─４．５％の下限に届くには、第４・四半期に６．３％の成長が必要だと述べた。

ただ、フィリピン経済の主要なけん引役である家計需要を高インフレがさらに抑制する恐れがあり、この成長率の達成は難しい見通しだ。１０月のインフレ率は前年同月比７．８％と、約３年ぶりの高水準に加速した。バリサカン氏は、食品と燃料の価格上昇により、消費者物価は高止まりする可能性が高いと述べた。

第３・四半期の家計消費の伸び率は２．４％と、４四半期連続で鈍化。政府消費の伸び率も第２・四半期の８．３％から６．８％に減速した。

農業生産が第２・四半期の２．９％増から４．８％減に転じたことも、経済の低調な伸びにつながった。

バリサカン氏は、政府が掲げる２７年の成長率目標５─６％は依然達成可能だが、力強い投資、物価上昇圧力の緩和、治水事業を巡る汚職疑惑で打撃を受けた企業信頼感の回復が必要になると述べた。

第３・四半期の政府のインフラ支出は１５．１％減と、６四半期連続で減少した。第２・四半期は３３．４％減だった。

フィリピン中央銀行はインフレ抑制に向け、１０月の予想を上回る５０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを含め、４月以降に計１２５ｂｐの利上げを実施した。これが借り入れコストを押し上げ、成長への新たな逆風となっている。

items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - ＮＴＴや三菱電機、三菱ＵＦＪ銀行など５社は９日、多数の低軌道衛星で地球を広くカバーする「メガコンステレーション」の構築・運用とサービス提供で協業を検討すると発表した。通信や観測、測位に加え、データ処理・保管機能を持つ「宇宙データセンター」などの事業化を目指す。

３社のほか、日本政策投資銀行とＮＴＴドコモビジネスが覚書を結んだ。ＮＴＴは光電融合技術を使った次世代通信、三菱電機は衛星開発やシステム全体の設計など、各社が知見を持ち寄りオープンで相互接続を前提とした事業の構築を目指す。

複数の衛星を連携させる衛星コンステレーションは、測位や防災・減災、安全保障などの分野で社会インフラとして活用される機会が増えている。米スペースＸが展開するスターリンクが代表。個々の衛星のカバー範囲は狭いものの、地表に近いため高速で低遅延の通信が期待できる。

items.title: Why Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang: All you need to know
items.author: Barkha Mathur
items.summary: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang will remain in his role as the company's board investigates reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation ...
items.body: US chipmaker Nvidia has launched an independent investigation following reports that its founder and Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation, the company's board of directors said in a statement on Sunday. The announcement follows reports by various publications that a Chinese businesswoman, Alice Huang, allegedly developed a close relationship with Jensen Huang while gathering information for Beijing. The board, however, has said it has no reason to believe that US national security or Nvidia's confidential information was compromised. What exactly happened? The New York Times reported on Saturday that China's Ministry of State Security had recruited Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, to gather intelligence on Jensen Huang. According to the report, a memo circulated among senior policymakers in the Trump administration last spring cited intelligence that Alice Huang was working for China's top intelligence agency. The alleged objective was to obtain information about Nvidia and its CEO, including potentially influencing the company to support making its most advanced AI chips available to China. Alice Huang was associated with Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed, which has been a significant Nvidia customer. The New York Times reported that Megaspeed had purchased more than $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia chips over the preceding two years. The reports also alleged that Jensen Huang had developed a close, personal relationship with Alice Huang. He subsequently acknowledged in a message to Nvidia's employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife and apologised to his family and colleagues. Why has Nvidia's board ordered an investigation? The board announced that it was initiating an independent investigation in light of the reporting. A committee of independent directors, assisted by external independent legal counsel, will oversee the inquiry. The board has made three points clear:It considers US national and economic security paramount to Nvidia and its shareholders.It has no reason to believe that national security or Nvidia's secrets were compromised.Huang supports the investigation and has committed to cooperating fully.The board has also reiterated its confidence in Huang and his leadership team. He is expected to continue leading Nvidia while the inquiry proceeds. Why Chinese connection particularly sensitive? The US government has imposed export restrictions to prevent China from accessing the most advanced American semiconductor technology. The restrictions are intended to limit China's ability to develop advanced AI and other strategic technologies with potential military applications. The New York Times reported that the alleged intelligence operation was intended not just to gather information but potentially to influence Nvidia's position on chip exports to China. Megaspeed's business relationship with Nvidia is also relevant because US authorities have reportedly scrutinised the company over suspicions that it helped Beijing obtain advanced chips restricted from export to China. The allegations have also gained political attention and three Republican committee chairs in the US House of Representatives asked Huang to brief Congress on his interactions with Alice Huang and Nvidia's safeguards for protecting sensitive information. They said the reports raised national security concerns about China's potential access to sensitive US technology and information. They sought a response by November 11. US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that he had not discussed the allegations with Huang, but described him as an honourable person and praised his contribution to Nvidia. ALSO READ: What Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in email as board launches probe Why is Nvidia valuable? Nvidia sits at the centre of the US-China technology rivalry. Its advanced graphics processing units (GPUs) are essential for training and running sophisticated AI models. Its CUDA software platform allows developers to build and run applications on Nvidia GPUs. Thus, the company has become one of the most important suppliers of the infrastructure powering the global AI industry. Nvidia's latest reported quarterly results show that data centre operations accounted for the overwhelming bulk ($89 billion) of its quarterly revenue ($96.2 billion). For the full fiscal year 2026, Nvidia reported revenue of $215.9 billion, up 65 per cent from the previous year. Nvidia has become the world's second-most valuable publicly listed company after Apple, with a market capitalisation of approximately $4.5 trillion. But its stock has beein experiencing considerable volatility in recent weeks. As of November 6, Nvidia shares closed at approximately $186.64. The stock had fallen for five consecutive weeks and was around 22 per cent below its October 6 record closing level. The decline had wiped out approximately $1.27 trillion in market value from its peak. ALSO READ: Nvidia CEO Huang admits affair with Chinese spy, company launches probe The investigation introduces another source of uncertainty for a stock already facing pressure from concerns about the sustainability of AI spending. Reuters quoted Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co as saying that the investigation could create risks for the stock because of Huang's importance to Nvidia's global strategy. However, the market reaction is yet to be seen as the board's announcement came after the US market had closed on Friday.

SEOUL, Nov 9 : South Korea's antitrust regulator said on Monday it was imposing a 300.9 billion won ($220.59 million) fine on e-commerce firm Coupang for abusing its dominant position in the food delivery market.
The Korea Fair Trade Commission (FTC) said Coupang required merchants to match favourable terms offered on rival platforms and penalised those that failed to comply, restricting competition in the delivery app sector.
Coupang required restaurants to match six conditions, including menu prices, minimum order amounts, discounts and delivery charges, the FTC said.

The regulator said the proportion of restaurants meeting the requirements rose to nearly 94 per cent in October 2025 from about 13 per cent in July 2023.
The FTC also fined Woowa Brothers, the operator of rival delivery app Baemin, 331.1 billion won for similar practices. Woowa Brothers did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Coupang said in a statement the penalty was excessive and more than 600 times the fine imposed in a comparable 2020 case involving another food delivery app.
It said the FTC had included revenue unrelated to the alleged conduct when calculating the fine, undermining its right of defence, and that it would challenge the decision through legal proceedings.
The ruling adds to tensions between the US-listed company and South Korean authorities, which fined Coupang 624 billion won in June over a 2025 data breach affecting more than 33 million customers.
Coupang has disputed the government's findings and handling of that case, while Republican US lawmakers have accused Seoul of discriminating against an American company, a claim South Korean officials reject.
Coupang has maintained an extensive lobbying and political operation in Washington, contributing to figures on both sides of the political aisle.
US Federal Election Commission records show that its political action committee, COUPAC, gave about $379,000 to congressional candidates and political committees from the start of 2025 through September 2026.
Recent records suggest a growing emphasis on cultivating Democratic ties ahead of the party's strong performance in the midterm elections, although COUPAC continued to support Republicans.

items.title: 契約済みＧＰＵ供給に影響なし、エヌビディアＣＥＯ問題＝韓国政府
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ９日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を巡る問題にもかかわらず、同社との契約に基づく画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ）の納入が支障なく進むと見込んでいる。科学技術情報通信省のリュ・ジェミョン次官が９日に明らかにした。

同次官は国会の予算委員会で、２０２５年補正予算で手当てされた１万個のＧＰＵがすでに到着し、使用されていると説明。「契約済みの数量については、生産および納入スケジュールに支障なく進められる見込みだ」と述べるとともに、事態の推移を注視するとした。

エヌビディアは８日、フアンＣＥＯが外国の情報活動の標的となっていたかどうかを調査すると発表。フアン氏を巡っては、中国政府に情報を渡していたとされる中国人女性と親密な関係にあったと報道されていた。

items.title: トランプ氏、米で世界最大級の航空宇宙見本市構想　2年後開催へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領と米航空宇宙局（ＮＡＳＡ）は６日、海外の主要航空ショーを上回る規模を目指し、同国で新たな航空宇宙産業の見本市を開催する構想を打ち出した。

トランプ氏は演説で、「ケープウィーク」と名付けたこの見本市をフロリダ州のケネディ宇宙センターで２年後から開催すると述べた。

ケープウィークは、同様の海外イベントに代わる場と位置付けられている。ホワイトハウスは９月、フランスのマクロン大統領がパリで同月主催した国際宇宙サミットへの参加を控えるよう、宇宙関連企業に促していた。

新たな見本市は、航空宇宙分野における米国の力をアピールし、世界からビジネスを呼び込むことが狙い。

世界では既に航空産業のイベントが数多く開催されており、パリ、英ファンボロー、ドバイの大規模な航空ショーには、企業幹部や政府関係者、技術者ら数千人が集まる。

items.title: Consumer firms absorb rising costs as inflation squeezes household budgets
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: India’s consumer giants are increasingly absorbing higher costs from surging inflation rather than passing them on to financially stretched consumers, a sign that weakening household purchasing power ...
items.body: By Satviki Sanjay and Ruchi Bhatia India’s consumer giants are increasingly absorbing higher costs from surging inflation rather than passing them on to financially stretched consumers, a sign that weakening household purchasing power is beginning to squeeze corporate margins. Westlife Foodworld Ltd., the operator of McDonald’s Corp.’s fast food chain stores in western and southern India, is “quite conservative” about raising prices beyond its standard annual hike to keep store traffic strong, its Chief Executive Officer Akshay Jatia told Bloomberg News. “We need to make sure that we don’t shoot ourselves in the foot over there.” Westlife is among at least 15 consumer-facing companies cautious on raising prices or holding the line, with firms such as KFC and Pizza Hut operators Devyani International Ltd. and Sapphire Foods India Ltd., leading paint maker Asian Paints Ltd., and retailer V-Mart Retail Ltd. all flagging concerns about an uneven demand outlook as a reason. India’s inflation accelerated to an almost two-year high of 5.54% in September, driven largely by food costs. Food inflation jumped to 7.74%, with prices rising sharply across vegetables, fruits, edible oils, sugar and prepared foods. Pricing pressure is also spreading beyond groceries, with costs for transport, restaurants and other services picking up, adding to the squeeze on household budgets. “With monetary and credit conditions tightening substantially, discretionary consumption is likely to moderate over the next few quarters,” Suvodeep Rakshit, an economist at Kotak Mahindra Bank, said in an interview. That has made many consumer brands wary that further price increases could chip away at sales growth. As a result, some of these companies that are putting off price hikes, such as PepsiCo’s India bottler Varun Beverages Ltd., are warning about lower margins. “There is margin pressure due to raw material price,” Varun Jaipuria, the company’s executive vice chair, told analysts on an Oct. 30 conference call. “Everybody is under pressure, they’re figuring out what to do and how do you negate the cost.” For liquor maker United Spirits, a unit of Diageo Plc in India, higher costs of living has started to hit lower-income consumers and have hurt its portfolio of entry-level spirits, Praveen Someshwar, its chief executive officer, said on an earnings call last month. “The bottom end of the urban consumer is feeling the inflationary pressure,” he said. That challenge extends to food products including snacks, with analysts at brokerages such as Motilal Oswal warning in a report published on Oct. 15 of the risk of higher commodity costs weighing on Nestle India Ltd. Indian consumption growth is expected to slow to 3.5% in the current quarter, compared with 5.2% in the three months to June 30, according to data from Worldpanel by Numerator. “We are seeing a kind of short-term stress on the budget,” Manoj Menon, the Mumbai-based director for commercial at the market research firm, said in an interview.  The signals on consumption are mixed. Tax collections and digital spending in India remain strong, suggesting consumers are still spending for now, even as surveys point to growing strain beneath the surface. HSBC Holdings Plc’s gauge of 100 growth indicators showed the breadth of economic expansion narrowing in September. Domestic activity is likely to soften after December as elevated costs erode consumers’ purchasing power, according to a note by HSBC economist Aayushi Chaudhary. She expects growth to moderate in the second half of fiscal 2027, amid weaker demand from the informal sector, rising costs and tighter financial conditions. To avoid hurting demand, consumer-goods maker Devyani is offering more products at entry-level price points, Manish Dawar, its group chief executive officer, told analysts in a post-earnings call on Nov. 2. “With food inflation firming and interest rates beginning to rise, we expect discretionary spending to stay under pressure,” he said.  Instead of raising prices across the board, Nestle India is focusing on “operational efficiencies” to cushion its bottom line from higher costs, the company said last month when it reported second-quarter results. The caution follows price increases by Nestle and other big consumer companies earlier in the year after commodity costs surged amid the Middle East conflict. For now, the annual festival season may provide a buffer, with demand for staples expected to remain resilient as spending builds toward Diwali in November. This period usually sees strong spending patterns and historically has accounted for nearly a third of annual sales for many consumer companies.  Still, the disconnect between headline growth of around 7% and “what households and businesses are experiencing on the ground raises concerns about the strength of the consumption outlook,” Shumita Deveshwar, an economist at TS Lombard, said in an interview. “The big question is how much of the cost burden companies can absorb before it starts weighing on demand.”

Nov 9 : Liam Lawson confirmed his status as the best of the midfield drivers with seventh place at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Sunday but still can do nothing but hope for the best when it comes to a spot on the grid for next season.  
The Racing Bulls driver swept past eventual race winner Lando Norris to take second place early on in a wet-dry race at Interlagos before being overhauled by quicker cars and settling for six points. 
It was the 15th time the New Zealander had scored points in 20 Grands Prix this season - a more consistent return than all but Lewis Hamilton, world champion Kimi Antonelli, Charles Leclerc, Max Verstappen, George Russell and Lando Norris. 
"I mean, crazy race," Lawson told reporters. "Honestly, I had a really good start. Good grip in Turn 1. Obviously made up a place, and then to be honest, I was thinking I might try and attack Kimi at some point in the lap.

"But yeah, just once the pace stabilises, they're a lot quicker than us, and we started to pull back. We were damaging our tyre, I think, quite a lot more than them. And then I think the pace on the dry was okay." 
"They" are the big four teams - Mercedes, Red Bull, Ferrari and McLaren - whose eight drivers between them have locked up all the podium spots this season. 
Lawson had two races among them, stepping up to replace injured Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar at the Italian and Spanish Grands Prix and finishing 14th and sixth. 
It was a reminder of his two-race spell as Verstappen's teammate at the start of last season before he was summarily despatched back to Racing Bulls and replaced by Yuki Tsunoda.
Memories of that relegation have proved hard to shift despite Lawson's consistency since, and the 24-year-old has not yet been confirmed as a Racing Bulls driver for next season.
Unlike teammate Arvid Lindblad, the Red Bull organisation perhaps no longer views Lawson as a young talent to be developed and 19-year-old junior driver Nikola Tsolov has been strongly linked with a seat in 2027.
Question marks over Lawson's judgement have also been around since he arrived in Formula One in 2023, most recently articulated by four-times world champion Verstappen after the two drivers collided in practice in Mexico last month.  
"If I were him, I would act a little smarter, and when you're fighting for your seat, it's not very smart behaviour," said the Dutchman.
Lawson said after Sunday's race that all he could do while Racing Bulls boss Alan Permane makes his decision about next year was continue to enjoy his racing and keep the team at the top of the midfield of the grid. 
"I feel like Alan's been extremely supportive to me, and I appreciate that a lot, and I have enjoyed working closely with him and with the team this year," he said. 
"But obviously it's a big organisation."

items.title: 中国、対米24％追加関税・港湾料徴収停止を2カ月延長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ９日 ロイター] - 中国国務院（内閣に相当）は、米国からの輸入品に対する２４％の追加関税の適用停止を１０日午後１時１分から２カ月間延長すると発表した。１０％の追加関税は維持する。

両国は９月にワシントンで開いた首脳会談後、６００億ドル規模の相互関税引き下げ案を提案した。対象には米国産農産物も含まれ、その規模は２０２４年の輸入実績で約１７０億ドルに相当する。ただ、計画はまだ最終決定されていない。

国務院の関税税則委員会は声明で、今回の延長は「中米両国首脳のワシントン会談で得られた成果と合意を履行する」ためだと説明。また、「司法判断で無効とされた国際緊急経済権限法（ＩＥＥＰＡ）に基づく関税を、通商法３０１条に基づく関税に置き換える意向を米国側が繰り返し表明していることに留意している」と表明した。

さらに、米国製品に対する一部の追加関税の適用停止を継続することは、両国関係にとって安定的で予見可能な政策環境の確保に役立ち、中米経済・貿易関係の発展を促すとの認識を示した。「米国側が今後講じる措置を注視し、情勢の変化に応じて関税対抗措置を適宜調整する」と述べた。

また、中国交通運輸省は９日、米国関連の船舶に対する特別港湾料徴収停止措置を２０２７年１月１０日まで延長したと発表。海運および造船のサプライチェーン（供給網）の安全保障関連調査の停止も継続する。

items.title: 南ア地方選、国政与党ＡＮＣが低迷　主要都市で連立協議へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nellie Peyton　Sfundo Parakozov　Nilutpal Timsina

［ヨハネスブルグ　８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Nellie Peyton　Sfundo Parakozov　Nilutpal Timsina

［ヨハネスブルグ　８日　ロイター］ - 南アフリカで４日に行われた統一地方選挙の最終開票結果が８日発表され、国政与党のアフリカ民族会議（ＡＮＣ）は第一党を維持したものの、得票率は３０．７６％と、前回２０２１年の４５．５９％から大きく低下した。最大の商業都市ヨハネスブルクなど多くの都市で、過半数得票した政党がなく、今後、連立交渉に入る。

２位は最大野党の民主同盟（ＤＡ）で２４．６４％得票。ズマ前大統領が率いる「ウムコント・ウェ・シズウェ（ＭＫ）」が９．７６％で第３党となった。

ＡＮＣは、水道や電力などの公共サービスの不備などが批判され、地方選で得票率が低下傾向にあった。今回、ヨハネスブルクではＤＡが約３５％の票を獲得したのに対し、ＡＮＣは約２０％にとどまった。

ラマポーザ大統領は結果発表を受けて「民主主義の不朽の強さと、自らの代表を選ぶ南ア国民の主権的権利を称賛する」と述べた。

ＡＮＣのフィキレ・ムバルラ幹事長は、今回の結果を党にとって「壊滅的」だと表現した。

連立交渉が必要になる都市は２１年選挙の２倍以上に増えた。各党には市議会が招集されるまで１４日間の交渉期間が与えられている。

ラマポーザ氏は、各政党は謙虚な姿勢で交渉に臨むべきだとし、「国民の利益が、政党や代表者による政治的な報復や些細な争いに埋没してはならない」と訴えた。

アナリストらは、ヨハネスブルクなどの都市の安定に向けた最善の選択肢は、過去２年間の国政での枠組みにならい、ＡＮＣがＤＡと組むことだと指摘している。

しかし、両党は人種格差の是正といった重要課題においてイデオロギー的に対立している。

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 9 : UBS Chief Executive Sergio Ermotti said on Monday a sharp correction in AI stocks over the last few weeks had been a reaction to excessively high hopes that investors had had for the sector.
Speaking at a UBS conference in Sydney, Ermotti said recent US midterm election results and the global debate about the implications of building up infrastructure could lead to delays in the AI sector delivering outcomes.
"And the market until very recently — of course in the last few weeks we saw some correction — has been pricing perfection."
Ermotti said while he was optimistic AI development would generate positive economic outcomes, that he personally believed "the timing on how quickly we will get there, it's a little bit exaggerated."

Trillions of dollars of world stock market value were wiped out last week over fears that Democratic election victories would bring tighter US regulations for the AI industry, though Wall Street equities mostly rallied on Friday.
Ermotti added that some aspects of UBS' own implementation of AI into its operations had been "slowed down" by the integration of Credit Suisse, which it agreed to acquire in a Swiss government-brokered rescue in 2023.
The collapse of Credit Suisse has also left UBS facing the prospect of tougher regulation in Switzerland, and the Zurich-based lender is assessing the long-term consequences of proposed new capital requirements for its ability to compete from its Swiss base.
On Monday, he described the country's response to the situation as "extremely emotional" and "idiosyncratic", contrasting it to authorities in the US and Europe that he said recognised the unintended consequences of over-regulation.

Source: Reuters

Asian stocks steady as AI, Middle East jitters recede

Asian markets and US equity futures made a steady start on Monday (Nov 9), after a wild week where doubts about demand for computer chips sent tech-heavy markets in Asia into some of their steepest falls in years.

A person rests in front of an electronic board displaying the Nikkei share average at a financial building in Tokyo on Jan 29, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

FAST

HONG KONG: Asian markets and US equity futures made a steady start on Monday (Nov 9), wobbling into positive territory after a wild week where doubts about demand for computer chips sent tech-heavy markets in Asia into some of their steepest falls in years.
MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rose 0.8 per cent after sliding 4.6 per cent last week. Japan's Nikkei index added 2.5 per cent while Korean shares made small gains.
Taiwan's benchmark rose about 2.5 per cent after notching its heaviest weekly drop for two decades last week, when fears about AI profitability and infrastructure demand turned into a rout following wins by Democrats at US midterm polls .
US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis, were a touch higher. On Friday, Wall Street equities rallied to end a chaotic week after heavy AI-related selling, helping to calm some nerves.
